questions.skill: Make formal constructions with a compass and straightedge
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 9 as a second forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: Use a compass and a straightedge to construct the perpendicular bisector of segment AB. Leave your construction arcs showing.
questions.prompt_markup: Use a compass and a straightedge to construct the perpendicular bisector of segment AB. Leave your construction arcs showing.
questions.correct_answer: Two pairs of arcs with the same radius (more than half of AB), centered at A and at B, meeting above and below AB, and the line through the two meeting points. It crosses AB at its midpoint at a right angle.
